name: TextField
description: Input field for the React Native mobile app, 7 types: text, left-icon, dropdown, date-picker, mobile, currency, unit. Optional label/caption wrapper. Not the same shape as web-ds's TextInputFluid (a different, floating-label pattern) — ported from accounting's discrete-type TextField instead.
notes: Web's :focus-within border is tracked via local onFocus/onBlur state. inputMode/pattern/dataReq (web-only concepts) dropped; inputType maps to RN's keyboardType/secureTextEntry instead.
